facts.business: Fractal Industries Limited is a specialised, end-to-end supply chain management company serving the e-commerce fashion industry, integrating garment design, sourcing, manufacturing with warehousing, fulfilment and supply chain management, and developing its proprietary brand 7ate9.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: IPO proceeds receipt, accounting treatment of IPO related expenses, utilisation of IPO proceeds against objects of the issue, and verification of IPO details (shares issued, issue price, allotment, listing) with BSE filings and statutory records.

facts.related_party_note: Material Related Party Transactions approved with M/s. Nested Brands Private Limited for purchase/sale and labour charges of goods and materials not exceeding Rs 10 Crore for the financial year 2026-27.
